access_path: Tencent PostgreSQL -> GitHub historical relay -> ChatGPT

methodology.metrics_basis: qfq captured at backfill time; retrospective, not point-in-time adjusted price
methodology.daily_pct_change_basis: unadjusted close/previous exchange-session close; corporate actions may differ from exchange percentage
methodology.pct_change_notice: Provider daily percentage unavailable; pct_change is computed unadjusted close return, adjusted_daily_return_pct is qfq close return. Neither is certified exchange-reported percentage.
methodology.drawdown_basis: negative close-to-close drawdown, includes baseline close; not intraday maximum drawdown
methodology.interval_baseline: last exchange session before 2026-10-26; unavailable baseline yields null
methodology.scope_note: Union of available official rosters, listing-date filtered. Historical delistings absent in all saved rosters cannot be guaranteed.
methodology.missing_policy: No zero imputation, no price forward fill, no inferred suspension confirmation; unavailable metric is null.
methodology.crosscheck: Five stocks / 75 daily bars matched independent Sina OHLC within 0.011 yuan and volume/amount within 0.5% or 100 units; sixth stock 689009 unavailable from Sina. Not full-market verification.
